title: Charging key-point rule features + simple classifiers as a non-deep-learning baseline
motivation: Test whether a minimal, domain-motivated description of the charging profile (CC/CV transition, peak power, decay rate, end level, abrupt cut-off) is sufficient at low label budgets. If it approaches full fusion at 1% labels, the necessity of the learned/foundation-model branches is challenged; if it is clearly below DYN/TCN+DYN, the richer feature engineering is supported.

data_protocol.split: with_random_seed(load_config('configs/moment.yaml'), seed); normalize='none'; same seed-specific train/validation partition as E18
data_protocol.training_subset: tcn_moment.data.stratified_train_subset_indices(y_train, ids_train, fraction, seed), identical to E18
data_protocol.split_manifest_location: written under the output directory, not artifacts/splits
data_protocol.evaluation: validation only; test split is neither scored nor used

key_point_features.input: valid raw-scale observations x[0:L]; no normalization
key_point_features.smoothing: centred moving median of width 5 (window truncated at the edges), used to locate key points and levels

definitions.peak_power: P_pk = max of smoothed curve (raw units); first maximum defines t_pk (approximate CC-to-CV transition)
definitions.cc_rise: (P_pk - P_0) / P_pk, P_0 = median of the first 5 raw samples
definitions.cc_slope: OLS slope of raw x on [0, t_pk] divided by P_pk (0 if fewer than 3 points)
definitions.cv_slope: OLS slope of raw x on [t_pk, L-1] divided by P_pk (0 if fewer than 3 points)
definitions.half_decay: samples from t_pk until the smoothed curve first falls to <= 0.5 P_pk; censored at L - t_pk
definitions.reaches_half: 1 if the smoothed curve falls to <= 0.5 P_pk after t_pk, else 0
definitions.end_ratio: P_end / P_pk, P_end = median of the last 5 raw samples
definitions.max_drop: largest single-step decrease of raw x divided by P_pk (abrupt cut-off indicator)
definitions.profile_residual: RMS of raw x minus the two-segment least-squares line fit split at t_pk, divided by P_pk

models.primary: key-point features + StandardScaler + multinomial LogisticRegression; C selected from {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100} by 3-fold stratified CV (macro-F1) on the labelled training subset only
secondary: key-point features + HistGradientBoosting with the fixed E18 DYN parameters (isolates feature information from classifier capacity)
60-D DYN features + the same logistic regression (isolates classifier choice for DYN)
models.fidelity_check: 60-D DYN + HGB with fixed E18 parameters must reproduce E18 dyn_hgb per-seed validation macro-F1; validation ids and labels must equal the E18 prediction files

paired_comparisons: per-seed paired differences against E18 full, tcn_dyn, dyn_hgb, f15_hgb and multirocket; mean, sample SD, positive-seed count and descriptive 95% t interval

interpretation_criteria_fixed_before_run.challenges_necessity: key-point + LR within 1.0 pp of E18 full fusion at the 1% budget (paired mean)
interpretation_criteria_fixed_before_run.supports_feature_engineering: E18 tcn_dyn and dyn_hgb each exceed key-point + LR by at least 2.0 pp at the 1% budget in 4/4 seeds
interpretation_criteria_fixed_before_run.otherwise: report as intermediate without a directional claim

notes: No hyperparameter or feature definition is changed after results are seen; any change requires a new protocol version.
CPU only; no MOMENT or TCN retraining.
